map.录入多种药物与服药频次，自动生成全天用药时间表，提示各次用药间隔与注意事项，帮助: Enter several drugs and dosing frequencies to generate a full-day medication schedule automatically, with reminders for intervals and precautions, helping elderly patients take medicine regularly and safely.
map.多病共病老人常需多种药物，用计划表梳理药名、剂量、频次与首次服药时间。: Elderly people with multiple conditions often take several drugs; use a schedule to organize drug names, doses, frequency and first dose time.
map.按 24 小时制排布给药点，避免漏服/重复并提示相互作用。: Lay out dosing points on a 24-hour clock to avoid missed or duplicate doses and flag interactions.
map.复杂方案建议与医生/药师核对，尤其抗凝、降糖、降压类。: Have complex regimens checked by a doctor or pharmacist, especially anticoagulants, glucose-lowering and blood pressure drugs.
map.：逐项添加『药名-剂量-间隔(小时)-首次时间』，如『降压药 1片 间隔24 首: : add entries one by one as "drug name - dose - interval (hours) - first time", e.g. "antihypertensive, 1 tablet, interval 24, first at 08:00", and the tool derives subsequent dose times from the interval and generates the daily schedule.
map.：将给药点叠加到一天时间轴，可发现是否多个药撞在同一时刻需分开、或某时段空腹/餐: : overlaying dosing points onto a day timeline reveals whether several drugs land on the same moment and need separating, or whether fasting/after-meal requirements conflict in a given period, making it easy to confirm with a pharmacist in advance.

map.多药同服要注意什么？: What to watch when taking several drugs together?
map.重点查相互作用与给药时机（空腹/餐后）、重复成分（如多种感冒药含同种成分）、以及: Focus on interactions and timing (fasting/after meals), duplicate ingredients (several cold remedies containing the same component) and how liver and kidney function affect the dose. Always have changes checked by a doctor or pharmacist.
map.漏服了怎么办？: What if I miss a dose?
map.切勿自行加倍补服。多数情况按『想起即补、若近下次给药则跳过』原则，具体遵药品说明: Never double up on your own to make up a missed dose. Usually follow "take it when remembered, skip if the next dose is due soon", and consult the drug label or a pharmacist to avoid overdose.
